Maybe the high cost of school causes more students to be working more hours, cutting into exam preparation time. Maybe students are no longer putting all their eggs in one basked, so they're not as thoroughly focused on each single goal. Maybe law schools have reduced the quality of their instruction in order to cut costs. Maybe they're still living with their parents and that's driving them nuts.
